clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Field Marshal Snowfall directs the Alliance's preparations for war. The dwarven military officer tracks the supplies gathered to face the silithid threat in Silithus and rewards those who aid the realm's preparations.

Field Marshal Snowfall directs the Alliance's war preparations from Ironforge's Military Ward. He sees the coming conflict as more than a border skirmish: it is a fight against an ancient enemy hostile to all creations of the Titans. Adventurers gather bandages, metal bars, leathers, herbs, and rations in great numbers. Snowfall oversees these stores so Alliance forces can be armed, armored, and fed when the march south to Silithus begins.

Blacksmiths, gatherers, cooks, and soldiers across Alliance lands all have a part in preparing for war. Snowfall tracks the effort, accepts commendation signets, and offers supply requisitions to volunteers. Once both factions have gathered the required supplies, the stores are packed and hauled south to Cenarion Hold. From there, the grand assault will target the qiraji swarms and the Old God behind the Scarab Wall.
